operators.name: Sagelio
operators.tariffChannel: direct card payment through station QR / Electromaps surface
positiveEvidence: Sagelio states that all network stations accept direct credit-card payment without app registration via station QR -> connector -> Activate with direct payment.
Sagelio states direct-card charging has the same charging cost as Electromaps plus Stripe commissions.
Current PUN-derived record for IT*SAG*ETACW2242822S7243*1 at Gragnano shows Type 2 22 kW and no tariff communicated to PUN.
negativePaths: No deterministic network-wide SAG price was found in current public first-party material.
PUN cannot currently supply the tariff for the Gragnano anchor.
operators.decision: Keep SAG station-level/fail-closed. Do not infer an Electromaps/eMSP price as a direct CPO price. Resume only with QR/payment payload or an explicit current first-party station tariff.
operators.blockingCondition: deterministic IT*SAG EVSE -> first-party/direct-payment tariff mapping

operators.name: Uattzy
operators.tariffChannel: Uattzy app/RFID direct service; third-party roaming separated
positiveEvidence: Uattzy first-party FAQ states the applied tariff is displayed for every connector before charging when using Uattzy app or associated RFID.
The FAQ states additional costs such as parking penalties or activation costs can be connector-specific and prices may vary with delivered power, session duration and stall occupancy time.
Uattzy explicitly distinguishes its own tariff from third-party app/RFID operator pricing.
negativePaths: A national price or simple power-class grid is not established by the first-party FAQ.
No public deterministic IT*UTZ EVSE tariff payload was exposed in this pass.
operators.decision: Keep UTZ station-level/fail-closed. The first-party tariff model itself proves connector-level/app resolution is required; do not extrapolate by power.
operators.blockingCondition: IT*UTZ EVSE -> Uattzy app/backend connector tariff payload

coherence.atlante: setAside-last and excluded from active count
coherence.queueNote: SAG and UTZ now have first-party evidence proving station/connector-level tariff resolution; generic network-wide tariff research should not be repeated without new evidence.

history.change: Advanced SAG and UTZ without price extrapolation: Sagelio direct QR/card path documented and Uattzy first-party FAQ establishes connector-specific tariffs/additional fees and strict separation from roaming pricing.
